title: Roasted Cabbage with Satay Sauce
description: Cabbage wedges roasted until browned and tender, then covered with a rich coconut, peanut butter and red curry sauce. Serve with rice or a small salad.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Cut the cabbage into eighths and place on the tray, drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 35-40 minutes until the cabbage is browned and tender, rotating the tray once halfway so all the wedges get even heat.
Meanwhile, bring all the sauce ingredients to the boil in a small pot. Stir well, reduce to low heat and cook for about 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat and stir in hot water until the sauce is the texture of pouring cream. Taste and add soy sauce or sugar as needed.
Transfer the hot cabbage to a serving plate, spoon a generous amount of sauce over each wedge and serve.
